Container.Name: reauth-bot
Container.Overview: Auto-reauth bot for Tape (tape#16). Runs the stock Playwright image with ops/reauth/reauth.py mounted in — no custom image to build. On a ~72h cadence it drives Tape's own /v1/admin/login flow inside a persistent trusted-device profile (skips 2FA) so the Schwab 7-day consent refreshes itself. One bot for the whole deploy (single Schwab app/token). REQUIRES a one-time interactive trusted-device seed — see ops/reauth/README.md. The trusted-device cookie MUST persist across updates (Profile volume); losing it forces a manual re-seed.
Container.Description: Auto-reauth bot — maintains the Schwab OAuth token for Tape (single bot, serves both tape instances). Stock Playwright image + mounted reauth.py. One-time trusted-device seed required (ops/reauth/README.md).

Config.Name: Profile
Config.Description: Trusted-device browser profile + /profile/shots debug captures (persist across updates; root-only, holds brokerage imagery)

Config.Name: Script
Config.Description: The bot script (tape repo ops/reauth/reauth.py), mounted read-only

Config.Name: SCHWAB_USER
Config.Description: Schwab login id (drives the trusted-device browser login)

Config.Name: TAPE_LOGIN_URL
Config.Description: Tape login endpoint the bot navigates to start consent

Config.Name: TAPE_TOKEN_URL
Config.Description: Tape token-status endpoint the bot reads to confirm refresh_issued_at advanced

Config.Name: REAUTH_NTFY_URL
Config.Description: Full ntfy topic URL for success/failure pushes (unset = log-only)

Config.Name: REAUTH_INTERVAL_HOURS
Config.Description: Refresh cadence in hours (~3d = 2+ tries per 7-day Schwab window)

Config.Name: REAUTH_RETRY_HOURS
Config.Description: Retry interval after a failed run, in hours

Config.Name: SEL_USER
Config.Description: Optional: username field CSS selector (blank = script default #loginIdInput)

Config.Name: SEL_CONSENT
Config.Description: Optional: consent/allow button selector list (blank = script default)

Config.Name: SEL_2FA
Config.Description: Optional: selector(s) that detect a re-appeared 2FA prompt (blank = script default). This gates the 're-seed required' alarm — most likely to need tuning at seed.
